name: BREAKERS
text:
If you want to buy an electrical circuit breaker for your infrared sauna, get one here.

Breakers, or electrical breakers, as you can tell from the name are a part of the electrical system of the sauna. These automatically operated electrical switches, also known as circuit breakers are there to protect your sauna from damage of poor quality electrical grid power.

Storms, overuse and other environmental factors may change the quality of the power output and electrical breakers are a line of defence. Sometimes they need replacing and we have a range of parts to help you fix your sauna or to protect your sauna. They can be used as a part of electrical overhaul or when upgrading the whole system.

If you’re not sure what in particular needs replacing, what replacement part to get, use the troubleshooting form.

We’re looking forward to helping you fix your sauna
text_short: Circuit breaker is the essential device and important safety mechanism of your infrared sauna. Breaker is commonly used in a special electrical panel that controls the amount of amps being sent through the electrical wiring. In the case of electrical wiring overload, breakers cut the power and save the equipment from further damage.
